prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Dubnium (Db) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a study or library in her element's kingdom
Time of day: midday — bright even light; a bright square of sunlight from the window on the floor.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a soft ribbed tank top and short cotton shorts — in bright kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera at her eye level; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small hand lantern low at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — dubnium: a heavy synthetic metal below niobium and tantalum, named for a research town founded in 1956 in pine and oak forest where two great rivers meet, a name said to hide an old word for oak; claimed almost at once by that river town and by a hillside laboratory across the ocean, it passed through several proposed names in a naming quarrel that lasted nearly thirty years before the river town's name was given to it; the town once held the largest particle accelerator on earth, a ring of iron magnets weighing tens of thousands of tonnes in a riverside hall, and its longest-lived form lasts about a day — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
